instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a boxing gym, the woman in the black tube top (R1) extends a left punch with her black boxing glove. The bearded man in the black t-shirt (R2) stands opposite her with his back partially to the camera, catching her gloved fist with his bare hand. A black heavy bag hangs between them under cool, bright gym lighting.

R2 catches R1's gloved fist with his bare hand rather than R1 catching R2's fist
R1's black boxing glove is the striking glove that meets R2's receiving hand
R2 stands opposite R1 with his hand positioned to receive her punch
a black heavy bag hangs between the two people
